description: This Java source file defines the EmailCampaign class, representing email campaign entities within the Fineract platform. It includes fields for campaign details, status, scheduling, and validation logic, along with methods for lifecycle management such as activation, closure, reactivation, and deletion.

classes.name: EmailCampaign
classes.description: Entity class representing an email campaign with fields for campaign details, status, scheduling, and lifecycle management methods.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new EmailCampaign instance from provided parameters and command data.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates campaign fields based on provided JsonCommand, tracking changes.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Activates the campaign, setting approval date and user, changing status, with validation.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the campaign, setting closure date and user, changing status, with validation.

methods.name: reactivate
methods.description: Reactivates a closed campaign, updating approval date, status, and visibility, with validation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Marks the campaign as not visible if it is in a closed state.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks if the campaign is currently active.

methods.name: isPending
methods.description: Checks if the campaign is pending.

methods.name: isClosed
methods.description: Checks if the campaign is closed.

methods.name: isDirect
methods.description: Checks if the campaign is of direct type.

methods.name: isSchedule
methods.description: Checks if the campaign is scheduled.
